# Verified Jobs Feed

Checks whether a job posting - and the hiring manager behind it - is
real, before you spend a pitch or a placement on it. Built to replace
manually vetting postings on job boards that don't check legitimacy
(e.g. Contena), using live company, hiring-manager, and posting-age
signals instead of relying on the board's own listing.

## Endpoints

### POST /check-job
Check a single posting. Send:
```json
{ "title": "string", "company": "string", "description": "string (optional)", "posted_at": "ISO 8601 date (optional)" }
```
Returns:
```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "company": "string",
  "verdict": "real | suspicious | ghost",
  "confidence": 0.0-1.0,
  "evidence": ["short strings citing the specific signals"],
  "pitch_line": "string or null",
  "contact": { "...": "verified contact info, or null" }
}
```

### POST /run-batch?role=...&location=...&limit=...
Scrapes fresh postings matching role/location and checks each one
through the same pipeline as /check-job. Returns the full batch of
verdicts plus total_cost_usd, the real measured Monid spend for the run.

### GET /cost
Returns total_measured_cost_usd - a running total of real provider
costs incurred, read from a receipts ledger, not estimated.

### GET /results
Returns every verdict recorded so far, most recent last.

## MCP

Also available as an MCP server at /mcp, exposing one tool:
check_job_posting(title, company, description, posted_at) -> same
shape as POST /check-job. Point any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, or
another agent) at this URL + /mcp to call it directly, no separate
integration code required.

## What this is not

Not a real-time job board aggregator with full listing coverage. Not
affiliated with Contena or any job board named for pricing comparison.
Verdicts are a probabilistic assessment from available signals, not a
guarantee - always use judgment before acting on a "real" verdict.
